title: Inference for Intractable Likelihoods
text: macOS Install Xcode command line tools: Install gfortran build CRAN uses, https://mac.r-project.org/tools/. installs /opt/gfortran, R looks Fortran libraries. gfortran version must match one R built : run look version number first path, e.g. -L/opt/gfortran/lib/gcc/aarch64-apple-darwin20.0/14.2.0 means gfortran 14.2 (used R 4.5 later). older gfortran /opt/gfortran gives linker errors missing one; CRAN page explains remove installing right version. Homebrew’s gfortran (brew install gcc) substitute: lives different place, linking fails errors (can see R expects libraries R CMD config FLIBS.) Linux Install R’s development toolchain, includes gfortran, e.g. sudo apt-get install r-base-dev (Debian / Ubuntu) sudo dnf install R-devel (Fedora / RHEL). Windows Install Rtools matching R version; includes compilers Fortran libraries.
code: xcode-select --install R CMD config FLIBS ld: warning: search path '/opt/gfortran/lib' not found ld: library 'emutls_w' not found

title: Inference for Intractable Likelihoods
text: ilike requires HDF5 C library. Install platform installing R package. macOS Linux (Debian / Ubuntu) Linux (Fedora / RHEL / CentOS) Windows HDF5 distributed via Rtools toolchain. Open Rtools MSYS2 shell (e.g. C:\rtools45\ucrt64.exe) run: Note: Rtools must already installed. pacman package manager bundled Rtools 4.x. upgrade HDF5 new major version later (e.g. brew upgrade hdf5), reinstall ilike links new library.
code: brew install hdf5 sudo apt-get install libhdf5-dev sudo dnf install hdf5-devel pacman -Sy mingw-w64-x86_64-hdf5

title: Mean-field dynamical system ensemble Kalman inversion (MFDS) — MFDS
text: derivative-free method Huang, Huang, Reich Stuart (2022, "Efficient derivative-free Bayesian inference large-scale inverse problems"). posterior fixed point filtering problem: iteration ensemble inflated mean (prediction) updated ensemble Kalman step augmented observation (data prior mean, observed simulated data parameters), noise scaled 1/delta_t. linear-Gaussian problems ensemble's mean covariance converge posterior's.
